# Proxied-server cmd test shard manifest.
#
# Format: <total_shards> <shard_number> <top_level_test_name>
#
# 15-shard split, bin-packed longest-processing-time-first by
# estimated cost (bd-init count; per-init migration chains dominate).
# Regenerate with scripts/ci/gen_proxied_shard_manifest.py after adding,
# splitting, or reweighting TestProxiedServer* functions. Newly-added
# tests not listed here hash-distribute via proxied-test-shard.sh.
#
# `bd serve`'s two suites are listed at the shard the hash fallback was
# already giving them, so this records the assignment without reshuffling
# the other 100. TestProxiedServerServeReadParity is the CLI/HTTP read parity
# oracle — the behavioural half of the anti-drift claim — so it being IN this
# lane, and this lane being required by PR Risk's CI gate, is the thing that
# makes that claim enforced on PRs rather than asserted in a doc comment.
